title: Learnt how to windsurf in just 2 hours!
text: I didn't think that I would be surfing and was able to windsurf for a solid 2 hours due to the amazing guidance of Estanis. It was so much fun and great to see the city in a new way! Very highly recommend:)
author: 870jo

title: Great first time on a board.
text:
Great first time with Teo. Fast intro and up to practical part.  Gives a hand if needed but let you try your own speed if wanted.
Thx Teo.
author: Trek694752

title: Nice beginner’s lesson | not too cold despite it being February
text: I had never tried windsurfing before, but it was really fun to try! Anywhere Watersports provided wetsuits so we’d stay warm in the water despite it being early February. We received some instructions on the beach, after which we got on a boat and took turns trying out the windsurfing on the water. I’m a bit scared of the sea, but the instructor was very understanding and stayed near me with the boat while I was trying to sail (and also gave advice on what to do differently), which was helpful!
author: amarins1995
